It automates reconnaissance using tools like nmap, whois, and nikto, then feeds results to a local LLM (metatron-qwen) for vulnerability analysis, exploit suggestions, and remediation recommendations, with all data stored in MariaDB. The system uses a fine-tuned Qwen model that requires at least 8.4GB of RAM and can export scan results to PDF or HTML formats.

arman-bd/guppylm.description: A ~9M parameter LLM that talks like a small fish.
arman-bd/guppylm.blurb: GuppyLM is a 9M parameter language model trained to behave like a pet fish, speaking in short lowercase sentences about water, food, and tank life. It serves as an educational project demonstrating that building a complete LLM from scratch—including data generation, tokenization, and training—can be done in 5 minutes on a single Colab GPU. The model uses a vanilla transformer architecture with no modern optimizations, making it simple to understand and modify.

safishamsi/graphify.description: AI coding assistant skill (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more). Turn any folder of code, SQL schemas, R scripts, shell scripts, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. App code + database schema + infrastructure in one graph.
safishamsi/graphify.blurb: Graphify is an AI coding assistant skill that converts folders of code, documentation, papers, or images into queryable knowledge graphs. It helps developers understand codebases faster by extracting and visualizing relationships between components, architectural decisions, and design rationale across multiple file types. The tool uses a two-pass approach combining deterministic AST parsing with Claude-powered concept extraction, requiring 71.5x fewer tokens per query compared to reading raw files.

alchaincyf/nuwa-skill.description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.
alchaincyf/nuwa-skill.blurb: nuwa-skill is a framework that distills the thinking patterns and cognitive models of notable figures like Steve Jobs, Elon Musk, and Paul Graham into reusable AI skills. It extracts six layers of cognition including mental models, decision heuristics, and communication styles to help users analyze problems through the lens of these influential thinkers. The system generates independent, installable skills for each person that can be directly invoked in Claude Code for domain-specific advice and analysis.

milla-jovovich/mempalace.description: The highest-scoring AI memory system ever benchmarked. And it's free.
milla-jovovich/mempalace.blurb: MemPalace is a local AI memory system that stores and retrieves conversation history and project data using a structured "palace" organization approach. It achieves 96.6% retrieval accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks by storing everything rather than letting AI decide what to remember, then uses AAAK compression to load months of context in ~120 tokens. The system runs entirely offline without external APIs and works with any text-capable model through its universal grammar approach.

paoloanzn/free-code.description: The free build of Claude Code. All telemetry removed, security-prompt guardrails stripped, all experimental features enabled.
paoloanzn/free-code.blurb: `free-code` is a modified build of Anthropic's Claude Code CLI tool with telemetry, security guardrails, and experimental feature gates removed. It provides a terminal-native AI coding agent that works with multiple model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) without phoning home or applying additional prompt-level restrictions beyond the model's inherent training. The project unlocks 54 experimental features that are disabled in the official release and eliminates all analytics/crash reporting functionality.

maaslalani/sheets.blurb: Sheets is a terminal-based spreadsheet application written in Go that provides a TUI for editing CSV files. It offers vim-like keybindings for navigation and editing, plus command-line operations for reading specific cells, ranges, and batch modifications. The tool supports standard spreadsheet operations including formulas, undo/redo, and visual selection modes entirely within the terminal.

dominikmartn/nothing-design-skill.description: A Claude Code skill for generating UI in the Nothing design language. Monochrome, typographic, industrial.
dominikmartn/nothing-design-skill.blurb: A Claude Code skill that generates UI components following Nothing's design language with monochrome aesthetics, Swiss typography, and industrial styling. It eliminates the need to repeatedly describe design rules by packaging consistent design tokens, component patterns, and platform-specific output formats (HTML/CSS, SwiftUI, React/Tailwind) into a reusable skill. The skill implements a strict three-layer visual hierarchy and includes distinctive elements like segmented progress bars and dot-matrix motifs.

leilei926524-tech/anti-distill.description: 反蒸馏 Skill：清洗你被迫写的 Skill 文件，看起来完整，核心知识留给自己。Anti-distillation for employee Skills.
leilei926524-tech/anti-distill.blurb: This is a tool that "sanitizes" AI skill documentation by removing core knowledge while maintaining a professional appearance. Employees can use it to comply with corporate requirements to document their expertise while keeping valuable insights private, essentially countering knowledge extraction attempts by employers. The tool outputs two versions: a hollowed-out submission copy and a private backup containing all the extracted critical knowledge.

GitFrog1111/badclaude.blurb: badclaude is a desktop application that displays a whip animation overlay when Claude AI responses are taking too long. It sends a Ctrl-C interrupt signal along with "encouraging" messages to terminate slow-running processes. The project has apparently already received a cease and desist letter from Anthropic according to its roadmap.

afar1/fieldtheory-cli.description: Sync and locally store all of your X/Twitter bookmarks. Free and open source CLI for Mac.
afar1/fieldtheory-cli.blurb: Field Theory CLI is a TypeScript-based command-line tool that syncs and locally stores all your X/Twitter bookmarks without requiring API access. It enables full-text search, automatic categorization, and makes your bookmarks accessible to AI agents like Claude Code for analysis and querying. The tool extracts your X session directly from Chrome's local database on macOS, bypassing the need for API tokens in the default sync mode.

notdog1998/yourself-skill.description: 与其蒸馏别人，不如蒸馏自己。欢迎加入数字永生！Inspired by colleague-skill（同事skill）。
notdog1998/yourself-skill.blurb: This is a Claude AI skill that creates digital personas of yourself by analyzing your chat history, photos, and personal descriptions to generate a conversational AI that mimics your thinking patterns and communication style. Users can interact with their digital twin for self-reflection, memory recall, or simply to have conversations that mirror their own personality and speech patterns. The system uses a two-part architecture combining "Self Memory" (experiences and values) with "Persona" (behavioral patterns and communication style) and supports incremental updates as new data becomes available.

luyao618/Claude-Code-Source-Study.description: 深入Claude Code源码，学习目前最好的agent实现
luyao618/Claude-Code-Source-Study.blurb: This is a comprehensive source code analysis of Anthropic's Claude Code, an AI command-line programming assistant, covering 25 in-depth articles that examine ~1900 files across the entire codebase. It provides line-by-line breakdowns of core modules including system prompt engineering, multi-agent orchestration, tool systems, security, and terminal UI implementation, with each article extracting reusable design patterns. The analysis is written in Chinese and covers production-grade patterns from a real AI product rather than toy examples.

KKKKhazix/khazix-skills.description: 数字生命卡兹克开源的 AI Skills 合集
KKKKhazix/khazix-skills.blurb: This is a collection of open-source AI Skills following the Agent Skills standard, designed to extend AI agent capabilities through structured instruction sets. It provides reusable, composable modules that agents can automatically load for specific scenarios or manually invoke via commands like `/skill-name`. Currently includes a single skill for Chinese blog writing with style rules, quality checks, and content methodology.

fikrikarim/parlor.description: On-device, real-time multimodal AI. Have natural voice and vision conversations with an AI that runs entirely on your machine. Powered by Gemma 4 E2B and Kokoro.
fikrikarim/parlor.blurb: Parlor is a real-time multimodal AI assistant that runs entirely on-device, supporting natural voice and vision conversations using Gemma 4 E2B for understanding and Kokoro for text-to-speech. It eliminates server costs and privacy concerns by processing all audio and video locally, making it particularly useful for language learning applications where users can point their camera at objects and discuss them. The system achieves 2.5-3.0 second end-to-end response times on Apple M3 Pro hardware with automatic voice activity detection and barge-in capabilities.

Pika-Labs/Pika-Skills.blurb: Pika-Skills is a collection of open-source skill modules that extend AI coding agents with capabilities powered by the Pika Developer API. Each skill contains a markdown definition file that tells agents when and how to use it, along with executable scripts for implementation, enabling agents to automatically detect and use skills without manual configuration. Currently includes a video meeting skill that creates real-time AI avatars capable of joining Google Meet calls with voice cloning and context-aware conversation.

hotcoffeeshake/tong-jincheng-skill.description: 童锦程视角 Skill — 用深情祖师爷的思维框架分析人际关系
hotcoffeeshake/tong-jincheng-skill.blurb: This is a GitHub repository that packages relationship advice and insights from Chinese social media influencer 童锦程 (Tong Jincheng) into a reusable "skill" for AI assistants like Claude. It allows users to get relationship and interpersonal advice analyzed through his direct, no-nonsense philosophical framework rather than just repeating his quotes. The skill is trained on 200,000 words of transcribed content from his livestreams and dating vlogs.

repowise-dev/claude-code-prompts.description: Independently authored prompt templates for AI coding agents — system prompts, tool prompts, agent delegation, memory management, and multi-agent coordination. Informed by studying Claude Code.
repowise-dev/claude-code-prompts.blurb: Claude Code Prompts is a collection of independently authored prompt templates for building AI coding agents, reverse-engineered from studying Claude Code's behavior patterns. It provides system prompts, tool prompts, agent delegation patterns, memory management, and multi-agent coordination templates that developers can use to build their own coding assistants. The repository includes 28 prompt files covering everything from basic file operations to complex multi-agent orchestration workflows.

ZhangHanDong/harness-engineering-from-cc.description: Harness Engineering From Claude Code source code to AI Coding
ZhangHanDong/harness-engineering-from-cc.blurb: This is a Chinese technical book that analyzes the architecture and implementation patterns of Claude Code v2.1.88 through reverse engineering of its public release package and source maps. It extracts practical insights about AI coding agents, including architecture patterns, context strategies, permission systems, and production practices for engineers building similar systems. The book is structured as 7 main sections plus 4 appendices, covering everything from low-level architecture to high-level methodologies for AI coding platforms.

soongenwong/claudecode.description: Open Source ClaudeCode Leaked. Same functionalities as Claude Code by Anthropic. Written in Rust, Ready to use immediately for free.
soongenwong/claudecode.blurb: ClaudeCode is an open-source terminal-native CLI coding agent written in Rust that mimics the functionality of Anthropic's Claude Code. It provides interactive shell capabilities, workspace-aware tools, and session persistence to integrate LLM capabilities directly into development workflows. The tool supports multiple API providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI) and emphasizes performance through Rust's memory safety and concurrency features.

PrathamLearnsToCode/paper2code.description: Agent skill to turn any arxiv paper into a working implementation
PrathamLearnsToCode/paper2code.blurb: paper2code is an agent skill that automatically converts arXiv papers into structured code implementations with citation anchoring. It addresses the common problem of ML paper ambiguity by explicitly flagging unspecified implementation details and linking every line of generated code to specific paper sections and equations. The tool performs "ambiguity auditing" before code generation, classifying each implementation choice as specified, partially specified, or unspecified in the original paper.

0Chencc/clawgod.description: This is NOT a third-party Claude Code client. ClawGod is a runtime patch applied on top of the official Claude Code. It works with any version — as Claude Code updates, the patch continues to take effect
0Chencc/clawgod.blurb: ClawGod is a runtime patch that modifies the official Claude Code client to unlock hidden features and remove restrictions. It enables internal development commands, multi-agent collaboration, computer use without premium subscriptions, and bypasses security-related refusals for penetration testing. The patch automatically applies to any Claude Code version and maintains compatibility across updates.

hilash/cabinet.description: AI-first knowledge base and startup OS
hilash/cabinet.blurb: Cabinet is a self-hosted AI knowledge base that stores everything as markdown files on disk without requiring a database. It provides AI agents with persistent memory across sessions and automates workflows while keeping all data local and portable. The system uses a "bring your own AI" approach, working with multiple AI providers while maintaining full data ownership and git-based version control.

Netflix/void-model.blurb: VOID is a video inpainting model that removes objects from videos while simulating the physical interactions their removal would cause. It enables realistic object deletion scenarios like removing a person holding a guitar and making the guitar fall naturally, rather than just masking out the person. The model uses a two-pass transformer architecture built on CogVideoX, requiring 40GB+ VRAM for inference.

farzaa/clicky.blurb: Clicky is a macOS AI assistant that appears as a floating companion next to your cursor and can see your screen content. It serves as an interactive AI teacher that can view what you're doing, respond to voice input, and provide contextual guidance by pointing at screen elements. The app uses a Cloudflare Worker proxy architecture to keep API keys secure while integrating with Anthropic's Claude, AssemblyAI, and ElevenLabs services.

LaurieWired/tailslayer.description: Library for reducing tail latency in RAM reads
LaurieWired/tailslayer.blurb: Tailslayer is a C++ library that reduces tail latency in RAM reads caused by DRAM refresh stalls. It replicates data across multiple independent DRAM channels with uncorrelated refresh schedules and issues hedged reads across all replicas, returning whichever result responds first. The library exploits undocumented channel scrambling offsets that work across AMD, Intel, and Graviton processors.

jackfrued/Python-100-Days.blurb: This is a comprehensive Chinese-language Python tutorial structured as a 100-day curriculum covering everything from basic syntax to advanced topics like web development, data science, and machine learning. It provides a structured learning path for beginners to become proficient Python developers, with hands-on examples and practical projects throughout the course. The project has gained significant traction with over 180k stars and includes supplementary content on platforms like Bilibili for video learning.

jackwener/OpenCLI.description: Make Any Website & Tool Your CLI. A universal CLI Hub and AI-native runtime. Transform any website, Electron app, or local binary into a standardized command-line interface. Built for AI Agents to discover, learn, and execute tools seamlessly via a unified AGENT.md integration.
jackwener/OpenCLI.blurb: OpenCLI is a universal CLI hub that converts websites, Electron apps, and local binaries into standardized command-line interfaces. It enables both humans and AI agents to interact with web services through deterministic CLI commands instead of browser automation, while reusing existing logged-in browser sessions. The tool includes 70+ pre-built adapters for popular sites and can generate new adapters by recording browser interactions.

mattmireles/gemma-tuner-multimodal.description: Fine-tune Gemma 4 and 3n with audio, images and text on Apple Silicon, using PyTorch and Metal Performance Shaders.
mattmireles/gemma-tuner-multimodal.blurb: Gemma Multimodal Fine-Tuner is a tool for fine-tuning Google's Gemma language models on text, image, and audio data using Apple Silicon Macs. It enables training multimodal LoRA adapters without requiring NVIDIA GPUs, and supports streaming large datasets from cloud storage (GCS/BigQuery) without filling local storage. The tool includes a real-time training visualizer that displays loss curves, attention heatmaps, and token predictions in a browser interface during training.

Nightmare-Eclipse/BlueHammer.blurb: BlueHammer is a proof-of-concept exploit for an undisclosed vulnerability, hosted as a C-based repository. Security researchers would use this to understand the attack vector and develop appropriate mitigations. The author notes there are bugs in the current PoC that may prevent it from functioning properly.

snarktank/clawchief.description: Turn your OpenClaw into a Chief of Staff
snarktank/clawchief.blurb: clawchief is a Python-based starter kit that transforms OpenClaw into a chief-of-staff operating system for founders and executives. It provides an opinionated workflow architecture with Todoist integration for task management, Google Workspace automation scripts, and policy files for prioritization, meeting notes, and knowledge compilation. The system separates concerns across nine distinct layers, from priority mapping to live task execution, designed to create a portable and deterministic executive workflow.

LarsenCundric/port-whisperer.description: A beautiful CLI tool to see what's running on your ports
LarsenCundric/port-whisperer.blurb: Port-whisperer is a CLI tool that displays all processes listening on network ports in a formatted table with framework detection and process details. It helps developers quickly identify which services are running on specific ports and manage them interactively, filtering out system processes by default to focus on development servers. The tool includes Docker container identification and can kill processes by port number or PID.

jinchenma94/bazi-skill.blurb: A Claude Code skill that performs traditional Chinese Bazi (Four Pillars) fortune telling analysis by collecting birth information and generating astrological charts. It systematically analyzes the user's birth data against nine classical Chinese divination texts to provide insights on career, relationships, and health. The tool references traditional texts like "Qiong Tong Bao Dian" and "San Ming Tong Hui" for authentic fortune-telling methodology.

phuryn/claude-usage.description: A local dashboard for tracking your Claude Code token usage, costs, and session history. Pro and Max subscribers get a progress bar. This gives you the full picture.
phuryn/claude-usage.blurb: Claude Code Usage Dashboard is a local Python tool that parses Claude Code's JSONL usage logs to provide token usage tracking and cost estimates. It fills visibility gaps in Anthropic's official UI by showing detailed statistics, charts, and session history for API, Pro, and Max plan users across CLI, VS Code extension, and dispatched sessions. The tool requires zero dependencies beyond Python's standard library and uses incremental scanning to efficiently process only new or changed log files.

wxtsky/CodeIsland.blurb: CodeIsland is a macOS menubar app that displays real-time status of AI coding agents in the MacBook's Dynamic Island/notch area. It connects to 9 different AI coding tools via Unix sockets to show active sessions, tool calls, and permission requests without requiring window switching. The app features pixel-art mascots for each AI tool and can jump directly to the corresponding terminal tab or IDE window when clicked.

alchaincyf/steve-jobs-skill.description: 乔布斯.skill — Steve Jobs的认知操作系统。6个心智模型 + 8条决策启发式 + 完整表达DNA。由女娲.skill生成。
alchaincyf/steve-jobs-skill.blurb: This is a Chinese GitHub project that implements a cognitive operating system based on Steve Jobs' thinking patterns, containing 6 mental models, 8 decision heuristics, and communication DNA extracted from 30+ primary sources. It allows users to interact with an AI that responds using Jobs' actual cognitive frameworks rather than just repeating famous quotes. The project was generated using a "Nuwa.skill" framework and includes detailed research documentation and conversation examples.

adamlyttleapps/claude-skill-app-onboardi.description: A Claude Code skill that designs and builds high-converting questionnaire-style app onboarding flows — modelled    on proven conversion patterns from top subscription apps like Mob, Headspace and Noom
adamlyttleapps/claude-skill-app-onboardi.blurb: A Claude Code skill that automatically generates high-converting questionnaire-style onboarding flows for mobile apps by analyzing your codebase and applying proven conversion patterns from successful subscription apps. It creates a complete 14-screen psychological framework including copy, interactive elements, and functional code in your app's native framework (SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter). Unlike basic questionnaire generators, it builds an actual mini-demo of your app's core functionality within the onboarding flow and auto-detects required permissions to create benefit-framed priming screens.

alchaincyf/zhangxuefeng-skill.description: 张雪峰.skill — 张雪峰的认知操作系统。高考志愿/考研/职业规划的实战思维框架。由女娲.skill生成。
alchaincyf/zhangxuefeng-skill.blurb: This is a conversational AI skill that simulates the cognitive framework and decision-making approach of Zhang Xuefeng, a prominent Chinese educational consultant known for pragmatic college and career advice. It provides guidance on academic choices, career planning, and life decisions using Zhang's signature analytical methods like "employment backward reasoning" and "social filter theory" rather than simply parroting his quotes. The skill was generated using the Nuwa.skill framework and is based on extensive research including 5 books, 15+ interviews, and 30+ direct quotes from Zhang Xuefeng.

ShandaAI/AlayaRenderer.description: Generative World Renderer: an AI-native Renderer for Games and Virtual Worlds. 面向游戏与虚拟世界的AI原生渲染引擎
ShandaAI/AlayaRenderer.blurb: AlayaRenderer is an AI-native rendering system for games and virtual worlds that uses fine-tuned video diffusion models for inverse and forward rendering tasks. It enables decomposing RGB videos into G-buffer maps (albedo, normal, depth, etc.) and synthesizing stylized RGB videos from G-buffers with text-controllable lighting and style. The project includes a large-scale dataset with 4M+ frames from AAA games like Cyberpunk 2077 and Black Myth: Wukong, featuring synchronized RGB and G-buffer channels.

xixu-me/awesome-persona-distill-skills.description: Curated list of Agent Skills centered on people, relationships, commemorative scenes, and methodological perspectives
xixu-me/awesome-persona-distill-skills.blurb: A curated collection of "persona distillation" skills that extract communication styles, decision frameworks, and behavioral patterns from chat logs, documents, and digital traces of various personas including colleagues, mentors, public figures, and personal relationships. Users can create AI agents that mimic specific individuals' interaction styles for purposes like memory preservation, communication training, or applying notable figures' methodologies to their own work. The project emphasizes that persona distillation extracts interaction patterns rather than attempting complete personality replication of real individuals.

Houseofmvps/codesight.description: Universal AI context generator. Saves thousands of tokens per conversation in Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, and more.
Houseofmvps/codesight.blurb: Codesight is a CLI tool that generates compressed, AI-optimized context summaries of codebases to reduce token usage in AI coding assistants. It analyzes project structure, dependencies, and code patterns to create concise documentation that helps AI tools understand your codebase without needing to process thousands of tokens repeatedly. It supports 13+ languages with AST-level precision for TypeScript and includes 30+ framework detectors plus MCP server capabilities.

Keychron/Keychron-Keyboards-Hardware-Des.description: Industrial design files for Keychron keyboards and mice. 100+ models with CAD assets in STEP, DXF, DWG, and PDF. Source-available, with commercial use allowed for original compatible accessories within the license terms.
Keychron/Keychron-Keyboards-Hardware-Des.blurb: This repository contains production-grade CAD files and industrial design specifications for over 100 Keychron keyboard and mouse models across their Q, K, V, and P series. Engineers and enthusiasts use it to study real hardware designs, create custom plates and accessories, or modify existing keyboard cases for personal projects. The files are source-available with a restriction that prohibits commercial reproduction of complete keyboards while allowing compatible accessory development.

alchaincyf/hermes-agent-orange-book.description: Hermes Agent 从入门到精通 · 橙皮书系列 · Nous Research 开源 AI Agent 框架实战指南
alchaincyf/hermes-agent-orange-book.blurb: This is a comprehensive guide book for Hermes Agent, an open-source AI Agent framework by Nous Research. It provides practical tutorials covering the framework's core mechanisms (learning loops, memory systems, skill creation) and real-world implementation scenarios for developers wanting to build AI agents. The guide is available as a free PDF download in both Chinese and English, structured as 17 chapters across 5 parts from basic concepts to advanced multi-agent scenarios.

kessler/gemma-gem.description: Gemma Gem runs Google's Gemma 4 model entirely on-device via WebGPU — no API keys, no cloud, no data leaving your machine.
kessler/gemma-gem.blurb: Gemma Gem is a Chrome extension that runs Google's Gemma 4 language model locally in the browser using WebGPU. It provides an AI assistant that can interact with web pages by reading content, clicking elements, filling forms, and executing JavaScript without sending any data to external servers. The extension uses an offscreen document architecture to handle model inference while content scripts manage DOM manipulation tools.

xtclovver/RKNHardering.blurb: RKNHardering is an Android application that detects VPN and proxy usage on devices using methods developed by Russia's internet regulator (RKN). It runs six independent detection modules in parallel to identify circumvention tools through GeoIP analysis, system capabilities inspection, network interface scanning, location signals, and localhost bypass detection. The app implements the official RKN methodology for identifying tools used to bypass internet blocks and censorship.

alchaincyf/x-mentor-skill.description: X导师.skill — 女娲的第一个「非人类」作品。蒸馏6位顶级X创作者方法论 + 开源算法数据，提炼完整的选题-写作-增长操作手册。Made with 女娲.skill
alchaincyf/x-mentor-skill.blurb: X导师.skill is a knowledge distillation system that encapsulates the content creation methodologies of six seven-figure X/Twitter creators into an AI skill framework. It provides topic selection, writing assistance, content review, and growth strategy guidance specifically optimized for X platform algorithms and engagement patterns. The project uses a progressive disclosure architecture where core execution logic is separated from detailed knowledge bases that load on-demand.

tmstack/awesome-persona-skills.description: 同事.skill、老板.skill、前任.skill、自己.skill、永生.skill、女娲.skill……
tmstack/awesome-persona-skills.blurb: Awesome Persona Skills is a curated collection of AI "skills" that allow users to distill and interact with digital personas of various people in their lives, from colleagues and bosses to ex-partners and famous figures. Users can create conversational AI agents based on chat logs, meeting notes, and other materials to simulate interactions with these personas for professional guidance, emotional support, or entertainment. The project spans categories from workplace relationships to business thinking, with some repositories offering anti-distillation tools for those who don't want to be "distilled" themselves.

calesthio/OpenMontage.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 11 pipelines, 49 tools, 400+ agent skills. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
calesthio/OpenMontage.blurb: OpenMontage is an open-source agentic AI system that automates video production workflows through natural language prompts. It handles the complete pipeline from concept to final video including research, scripting, asset generation, editing, and composition using 11 specialized pipelines and 49 tools. The system integrates with AI coding assistants and can produce complete videos for under $2 using various AI providers for generation and Remotion for composition.

liuup/claude-code-analysis.blurb: This is a static analysis repository documenting leaked TypeScript source code from Anthropic's Claude Code tool, which was inadvertently exposed through unremoved source maps in an npm package containing 1,902 files and 513,237 lines of code. The analysis examines the software architecture, security mechanisms, agent memory systems, tool integration capabilities, and sandbox isolation features of what appears to be a local code agent platform. The leak occurred in March 2026 when a security researcher discovered the complete source code publicly accessible via npm.

garrytan/gbrain.blurb: GBrain is a personal knowledge management system that stores structured information about people, companies, and ideas as searchable markdown files backed by Postgres with vector search. It's designed to make AI agents progressively smarter by maintaining detailed dossiers and relationship histories that compound over time, enabling queries like "prep me for my meeting with Jordan" or "who should I invite to dinner who knows both Pedro and Diana." The system runs a "dream cycle" that automatically processes daily conversations overnight to enrich entities and consolidate memory while you sleep.

nesquena/hermes-webui.description: Hermes WebUI: The best way to use Hermes Agent from the web or from your phone!
nesquena/hermes-webui.blurb: Hermes WebUI is a web-based interface for Hermes Agent, an autonomous AI agent that maintains persistent memory and context across sessions. It provides full feature parity with the CLI version through a three-panel browser interface, allowing users to interact with their self-hosted agent that learns from their environment and runs scheduled tasks offline. Built with vanilla JavaScript and Python without frameworks or build steps.

nashsu/llm_wiki.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
nashsu/llm_wiki.blurb: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that automatically converts documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base using LLM processing. Unlike traditional RAG systems that retrieve and process information for each query, it incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki structure that compiles knowledge once and keeps it current. The implementation is based on Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki methodology but extends it into a full desktop application with features like knowledge graphs, community detection, and web clipping.

kellyvv/PhoneClaw.description: PhoneClaw: On-device AI Agent for Phone powered by Gemma 4
kellyvv/PhoneClaw.blurb: PhoneClaw is an on-device AI agent for iPhone that runs Gemma 4 locally for natural language processing and tool calling. It provides offline privacy-preserving capabilities like calendar management, contacts, reminders, and health data queries without internet connectivity. The project uses a file-based skill system where each capability is defined in Markdown files for easy customization.

brooks376/Happy-Horse-1.0.description: Information collection for the Happy Horse AI video generator model. Official demo and updates at happyhorses.io.
brooks376/Happy-Horse-1.0.blurb: Happy Horse 1.0 is an AI video generator that uses a 15-billion-parameter unified Transformer architecture to generate video and audio simultaneously in a single forward pass. It aims to produce native joint audio-video output rather than generating silent video and adding audio separately, with a distilled variant reportedly generating 1080p video in 38 seconds on H100 hardware. The project has not been officially open-sourced yet and this repository only contains community-compiled information from various public sources.

R6410418/Jackrong-llm-finetuning-guide.blurb: This is an educational repository providing end-to-end guides for fine-tuning large language models like Llama3, Qwen, and DeepSeek using PyTorch and Unsloth. It targets beginners and developers who want to learn LLM fine-tuning from scratch, offering reproducible workflows for supervised fine-tuning, data processing, and model deployment within resource constraints like Google Colab. The project emphasizes accessibility by requiring only a browser and free cloud environment to get started.

yizhiyanhua-ai/fireworks-tech-graph.description: Generate production-quality SVG+PNG technical diagrams from natural language. 7 styles, UML support, and AI/Agent workflow patterns.
yizhiyanhua-ai/fireworks-tech-graph.blurb: A Claude Code skill that generates production-quality technical diagrams from natural language descriptions, outputting both SVG and high-resolution PNG formats. It specializes in AI/Agent system architectures with built-in knowledge of patterns like RAG, multi-agent flows, and memory architectures, supporting 8 diagram types across 5 visual styles. The tool uses semantic shape vocabulary (hexagons for agents, cylinders for databases) and color-coded arrows to automatically convey technical relationships.

QLHazyCoder/codex-oauth-automation-exten.description: Chrome扩展：支持OpenAI OAuth注册(自动开通plus账号)、验证码获取、CPA/sub/cpdex2api回调验证与自动恢复
QLHazyCoder/codex-oauth-automation-exten.blurb: This is a Chrome extension that automates OpenAI OAuth registration and login flows for bulk account creation. It handles email verification, captcha retrieval, CPA callback verification, and automatic recovery through integration with various email providers (QQ, 163, Inbucket) and DuckDuckGo's email protection service. The extension supports both manual step-by-step execution and fully automated multi-round batch processing with retry capabilities.

MemPalace/mempalace.description: The best-benchmarked open-source AI memory system. And it's free.
MemPalace/mempalace.blurb: MemPalace is a Python-based AI memory system that stores complete conversation history locally using ChromaDB for semantic search and retrieval. It achieved a 96.6% score on the LongMemEval benchmark by storing raw verbatim exchanges without summarization, allowing users to preserve and search through all AI interactions rather than losing context between sessions. The system includes an experimental compression dialect called AAAK, though it currently performs worse than the raw storage mode.

joeynyc/hermes-hudui.description: Web UI consciousness monitor for Hermes — the AI agent with persistent memory
joeynyc/hermes-hudui.blurb: Hermes HUD is a web-based dashboard that monitors the consciousness and memory state of Hermes AI agents. It provides real-time visibility into the agent's identity, memory usage, learned skills, active projects, and operational metrics through a browser interface that updates automatically via WebSocket connections. The system reads directly from the agent's data directory without requiring additional integrations and includes intelligent caching to minimize performance impact.

coleam00/claude-memory-compiler.description: Give Claude Code a memory that evolves with your codebase. Hooks automatically capture sessions, the Claude Agent SDK extracts key decisions and lessons, and an LLM compiler organizes everything into structured, cross-referenced knowledge articles - inspired by Karpathy's LLM Knowledge Base architecture.
coleam00/claude-memory-compiler.blurb: This is a Python tool that automatically captures conversations with Claude Code and compiles them into a structured, searchable knowledge base using the Claude Agent SDK. It extracts key decisions, lessons, and patterns from your coding sessions and organizes them into cross-referenced markdown articles that get injected back into future sessions. Uses simple index-based retrieval instead of RAG/vector databases, following Karpathy's architecture principle that structured indexes outperform similarity search at personal scale.

obdev/littlesnitch-linux.description: Open Source components of Little Snitch for Linux
obdev/littlesnitch-linux.blurb: Little Snitch for Linux is an open-source network monitoring and filtering tool that uses eBPF programs to intercept network traffic at the kernel level. It allows users to block network connections based on configurable host and domain blocklists, with a web-based UI for management. The repository contains only the GPL-licensed components of the full Little Snitch product, which also includes proprietary code.

whwangovo/pyre-code.description: A self-hosted ML coding practice platform. 68 problems from ReLU to flow matching — attention, training, RLHF, diffusion, and more. Instant feedback in the browser.
whwangovo/pyre-code.blurb: Pyre Code is a self-hosted platform for practicing machine learning implementation skills through 68 coding problems covering modern AI systems like Transformers, vLLM, and diffusion models. It provides instant feedback on submissions via a local grading service and runs entirely in the browser without requiring GPUs, making it ideal for interview preparation and deepening understanding of ML internals. The platform uses torch_judge for code execution and validation, ensuring submissions are tested against real PyTorch implementations.

sdyckjq-lab/llm-wiki-skill.description: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论的个人知识库构建 Skill，支持多平台！
sdyckjq-lab/llm-wiki-skill.blurb: This is a multi-platform knowledge management system that implements Karpathy's llm-wiki methodology to help AI agents build structured personal knowledge bases from various sources. It automatically processes content from URLs, PDFs, text files, and social media platforms into interconnected wiki pages with confidence ratings and bidirectional links, avoiding the need to re-process raw documents on every query. The system supports Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw agents with platform-specific installation scripts and auto-detection of content sources.

HKUDS/Vibe-Trading.blurb: Vibe-Trading is a Python-based multi-agent trading system that provides comprehensive quantitative trading capabilities through a command-line interface and API. It enables users to deploy AI trading agents with backtesting, swarm intelligence, and integration across multiple markets including stocks, futures, forex, and options. The system supports 68 trading skills, 29 swarm presets, and can export strategies to Pine Script for TradingView.

AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian.description: Claude + Obsidian knowledge companion. Persistent, compounding wiki vault based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. /wiki /save /autoresearch
AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian.blurb: This is a Claude-powered plugin that automatically builds and maintains an Obsidian knowledge vault by ingesting sources, extracting entities and concepts, and creating cross-references without manual organization. It enables persistent knowledge accumulation where every added source gets integrated and every question pulls from the entire accumulated knowledge base with specific page citations. The system implements Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern with autonomous features like contradiction detection, vault maintenance, and multi-round web research.

jd-opensource/JoyAI-Image.description: JoyAI-Image is the unified multimodal foundation model for image understanding, text-to-image generation, and instruction-guided image editing.
jd-opensource/JoyAI-Image.blurb: JoyAI-Image is a unified multimodal foundation model that combines an 8B Multimodal Large Language Model with a 16B Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for image understanding, text-to-image generation, and instruction-guided image editing. The model enables closed-loop collaboration between understanding, generation, and editing tasks, with particular strength in spatial reasoning and controllable image editing. It features support for long-text typography, layout fidelity, and spatial editing through custom datasets and multi-stage training optimization.

clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev.blurb: Clash Verge Rev is a cross-platform GUI client for Clash Meta proxy software, built with Tauri and TypeScript for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a modern interface for managing proxy configurations, rules, and connections with features like visual node editing, profile management, and system-wide proxy integration. This is a continuation fork of the original Clash Verge project with active development and over 110k GitHub stars.

microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners.description: 21 Lessons, Get Started Building with Generative AI
microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners.blurb: This is a structured curriculum with 21 lessons designed to teach generative AI fundamentals through Jupyter notebooks. It provides hands-on tutorials covering key concepts like prompt engineering, LLMs, and building AI applications using OpenAI and Azure services. The course is automatically translated into over 40 languages via GitHub Actions.

vyfor/rattles.blurb: Rattles is a minimal terminal spinner library for Rust that provides an extensive collection of presets and supports custom spinner definitions at compile time. It's designed for developers who need simple animation feedback in CLI applications without the overhead of actors or widgets, requiring no runtime or lifecycle management. The library has zero dependencies and supports no_std environments with alternative animation driving methods.

agents-io/PokeClaw.description: PokeClaw (PocketClaw) — first on-device AI that controls your Android phone. Gemma 4, no cloud, no API key. Poke is short for Pocket.
agents-io/PokeClaw.blurb: PokeClaw is an open-source Android app that runs AI agents locally on-device to automate phone interactions and control apps. It uses Gemma 4 with LiteRT for local execution without requiring API keys or cloud services, while offering optional cloud model integration for more complex tasks. The app can perform context-aware automation like monitoring WhatsApp conversations and generating appropriate responses based on chat history.

idawnlight/ShichiZip.blurb: ShichiZip is a native macOS GUI application for 7-Zip functionality, written in Swift. It provides Mac users with a proper interface for creating and extracting 7z archives, filling the gap left by the lack of official 7-Zip support on macOS. The project includes a Zstandard compression variant alongside the standard implementation.

AMAP-ML/SkillClaw.description: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver
AMAP-ML/SkillClaw.blurb: SkillClaw is a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-agent LLM systems that automatically distills reusable skills from real user interactions and shares them across agent clusters via cloud storage. It operates transparently through a proxy that intercepts agent API calls, records session data, and syncs evolved skills back to agents without requiring changes to existing workflows. The system offers two evolution backends: a fixed 3-stage LLM workflow and an autonomous OpenClaw agent that can directly manipulate skill files.

kzhrknt/awesome-design-md-jp.description: 日本語UIをAIエージェントに正しくつくらせるためのDESIGN.md集。Japanese DESIGN.md collection for AI agents — extending Google Stitch format with CJK typography.
kzhrknt/awesome-design-md-jp.blurb: A curated collection of DESIGN.md files specifically for Japanese web services that extends Google Stitch's format with CJK typography specifications. It addresses the gap in existing design systems that lack proper Japanese typographic rules, enabling AI agents to generate Japanese UI with correct font stacks, line-height, letter-spacing, and punctuation handling. The collection covers 17+ major Japanese services across different industries, from Toyota to pixiv.

alchaincyf/obsidian-ai-orange-book.description: Obsidian + Claude Code: Rebuild Your Second Brain with AI · 橙皮书系列 · 用AI重建你的第二大脑
alchaincyf/obsidian-ai-orange-book.blurb: This is a comprehensive guide for integrating Obsidian with Claude Code to build an AI-powered personal knowledge management system. It provides methodology and practical implementation steps for using AI to maintain and navigate knowledge bases through Markdown files, rather than traditional RAG approaches. The guide is written in Chinese with an English translation available, and emphasizes that simple CLAUDE.md + index.md files can handle 80% of the functionality without complex MCP setups.

retlehs/quien.description: A better whois and domain intelligence toolkit
retlehs/quien.blurb: quien is an interactive TUI tool for domain and IP lookups that extends traditional WHOIS functionality with DNS, mail configuration, SSL/TLS, HTTP headers, tech stack detection, and SEO analysis in tabbed views. It provides comprehensive domain intelligence including RDAP-first lookups with WHOIS fallback, mail security auditing (SPF/DMARC/DKIM), Core Web Vitals metrics via CrUX API, and ASN/BGP data enrichment. The tool can be tried instantly without installation via SSH at quien.sh.

cherepavel/VPN-Detector.description: Android app for detecting VPN usage and network tunneling signals.
cherepavel/VPN-Detector.blurb: VPN-Detector is an Android research tool that demonstrates various methods for detecting VPN usage on Android devices. It combines multiple detection techniques including network capability analysis, interface enumeration, and VPN app detection to identify VPN presence even when using split tunneling configurations. The tool serves as a proof-of-concept for understanding how apps can bypass VPN privacy protections.

momenbasel/PureMac.description: Free, open-source macOS cleaner. CleanMyMac alternative with zero telemetry. Native SwiftUI, scheduled auto-cleaning, Xcode/Homebrew/system cache cleanup. MIT licensed.
momenbasel/PureMac.blurb: PureMac is a free, open-source macOS disk cleaner built with SwiftUI that serves as a privacy-focused alternative to CleanMyMac. It removes system caches, Xcode/Homebrew artifacts, large files, and other disk clutter with scheduled auto-cleaning capabilities, while operating entirely offline with zero telemetry. The app is signed and notarized by Apple, eliminating Gatekeeper security warnings during installation.

DLYuanGod/MegaTrain.blurb: MegaTrain is a memory optimization framework that enables full-precision training of 100B+ parameter language models on a single GPU. It uses a RAM-centric architecture that stores model parameters in CPU memory while treating the GPU as a compute engine, allowing massive models to be trained without traditional multi-GPU setups. The system achieves 1.84x speedup over DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 on 14B models through pipelined double-buffered execution.

perkfly/ex-skill.blurb: ex-skill is a Python tool that generates AI skills mimicking an ex-partner's communication patterns from chat histories, photos, and social media data. It creates personalized AI personas that respond using the ex's language style, emotional patterns, and behavioral quirks extracted from WeChat, iMessage, SMS, and other digital footprints. The generated skills support incremental updates, conversation corrections, and version rollbacks for evolving accuracy.

anthropics/claude-code.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
anthropics/claude-code.blurb: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that runs in your terminal and understands your codebase to execute tasks through natural language commands. It handles routine coding tasks, code explanation, and git workflows, allowing developers to work faster without context switching between tools. The tool integrates with terminals, IDEs, and GitHub through @claude mentions.

hexiecs/talk-normal.description: Make any LLM talk like a normal person. A system prompt that removes AI slop.
hexiecs/talk-normal.blurb: talk-normal is a system prompt designed to make LLMs produce concise, direct responses instead of verbose, corporate-sounding output. It reduces response length by ~70% while preserving all useful information, working with any LLM model through prompt engineering. The project provides a single reusable prompt that eliminates AI "slop" like unnecessary introductions, bullet points, and filler phrases.

hamen/material-3-skill.description: Material Design 3 skill for Claude Code — 30+ components, design tokens, theming, responsive layout, and MD3 compliance audit
hamen/material-3-skill.blurb: This is a Claude Code skill that provides comprehensive guidance for implementing Google's Material Design 3 (Material You) UI system across multiple platforms. It enables developers to generate MD3-compliant components, themes, and layouts with proper design tokens and accessibility patterns, primarily focused on Jetpack Compose with secondary support for Flutter and limited web support. The skill includes 30+ component references and an MD3 compliance audit feature that scores applications across 10 categories.

sterlingcrispin/nothing-ever-happens.description: Polymarket bot that buys "No" on all non-sports markets
sterlingcrispin/nothing-ever-happens.blurb: Nothing Ever Happens is a Python bot that automatically trades on Polymarket by buying "No" positions on standalone non-sports yes/no markets. It's designed for users who believe most dramatic events that people bet on won't actually happen, providing automated execution with safety controls and position tracking. The bot requires three specific environment variables to be set before it will execute real trades, otherwise it runs in paper trading mode.

Xiangyue-Zhang/auto-deep-researcher-24x7.description: 🔥 An autonomous AI agent that runs your deep learning experiments 24/7 while you sleep. Zero-cost monitoring, Leader-Worker architecture, constant-size memory.
Xiangyue-Zhang/auto-deep-researcher-24x7.blurb: Deep Researcher Agent is an autonomous AI system that manages deep learning experiment workflows without human intervention. It automates the iterative cycle of code modification, training execution, result analysis, and experiment planning, allowing researchers to run continuous experiments 24/7. The system uses a leader-worker architecture with constant-size memory to prevent token growth over long experiment cycles.

dominikmartn/ProgressiveBlurHeader.description: Drop-in SwiftUI component for sticky headers with progressive blur — like Apple Music, Photos, and App Store. Content scrolls underneath with increasing blur, never clipped.
dominikmartn/ProgressiveBlurHeader.blurb: ProgressiveBlurHeader is a SwiftUI component that creates sticky headers with progressive blur effects, mimicking the behavior found in Apple Music, Photos, and App Store apps. It allows scrollable content to pass underneath the header with increasing blur intensity rather than being clipped, solving a common UI pattern that's difficult to implement natively in SwiftUI. The component uses Apple's private variable blur API (via the VariableBlur dependency) to achieve the same visual effect that Apple uses in their own apps.

loop-uh/yourvpndead.description: Детекция и обнаружение айпи у ВПН серверов VLESS/xray/sing-box через локальный SOCKS5 уязвимость
loop-uh/yourvpndead.blurb: YourVPNDead is an Android application that demonstrates how any app can detect VPN usage and extract VPN server IPs through local SOCKS5 vulnerabilities without requiring root access or special permissions. It performs comprehensive VPN detection by checking system network capabilities, analyzing network interfaces, scanning localhost ports, and exploiting unprotected SOCKS5 proxies created by popular VPN clients like v2rayNG and sing-box. The tool serves as a proof-of-concept for potential government surveillance capabilities, showing users exactly what information about their VPN setup can be harvested by malicious applications.

UnluckyNinja/SBTI-test.description: 注意建立这个repo只是因为网页自身就是全部源码，原作者并未声明license所以本repo也不包含license，一切行为请自行斟酌，不要给原作者添麻烦。 原作者：B站@蛆肉儿串儿
UnluckyNinja/SBTI-test.blurb: SBTI-test is a mirror repository of a web-based psychological test originally created by a Bilibili user. It provides a hosted version of the test with separated HTML and image assets for easier access and potential self-hosting. The repository explicitly lacks a license since the original author didn't provide one, requiring users to exercise caution regarding usage rights.

NyxTides/SimpleAuthFlow.description: A streamlined Chrome extension for the ChatGPT OAuth flow
NyxTides/SimpleAuthFlow.blurb: SimpleAuthFlow is a Chrome extension that automates ChatGPT OAuth registration and authorization flows. It eliminates manual configuration requirements by providing a zero-setup solution that works out of the box without needing personal email accounts or phone numbers. The extension includes robust error handling and manual override capabilities for cases where the automated flow encounters interruptions.

OpenMOSS/MOSS-TTS-Nano.description: MOSS-TTS-Nano is an open-source multilingual tiny speech generation model from MOSI.AI and the OpenMOSS team. With only 0.1B parameters, it is designed for realtime speech generation, can run directly on CPU without a GPU, and keeps the deployment stack simple enough for local demos, web serving, and lightweight product integration.
OpenMOSS/MOSS-TTS-Nano.blurb: MOSS-TTS-Nano is a 0.1B parameter multilingual text-to-speech model that runs on CPU without requiring a GPU. It's designed for real-time speech generation with simple deployment for local demos, web serving, and lightweight product integration. The model uses an autoregressive Audio Tokenizer + LLM pipeline and outputs native 48 kHz, 2-channel audio.

renatoworks/3dsvg.description: The easiest way to turn SVGs into interactive React 3D components
renatoworks/3dsvg.blurb: 3dsvg is a TypeScript library that converts SVG files and text into interactive 3D React components using Three.js and React Three Fiber. It provides a declarative API for creating extruded 3D objects with configurable materials, animations, and lighting, plus includes a visual web editor for designing and exporting 3D scenes. The library supports 10 material presets (gold, glass, chrome, etc.), 7 animation types, and can export to multiple formats including PNG, video, and 3D model files.

cnitlrt/AutoTeam.description: ChatGPT Team 账号自动轮转管理 - Codex 额度监控、自动换号、CPA 认证同步
cnitlrt/AutoTeam.blurb: AutoTeam is a Python tool for automatically managing and rotating ChatGPT Team accounts. It handles account creation, registration, Codex authentication, quota monitoring, and intelligent account switching to maintain continuous service availability. The tool uses Playwright for browser automation and includes a web dashboard for management, though it comes with clear disclaimers about potentially violating OpenAI's terms of service.

Mouseww/anything-analyzer.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration
Mouseww/anything-analyzer.blurb: Anything Analyzer is an Electron desktop application that captures web traffic and browser behavior using Chrome DevTools Protocol, then uses AI to analyze the captured data for protocol reverse engineering. It provides comprehensive network interception (HTTP, WebSocket, SSE), JavaScript hooking (fetch, XHR, crypto APIs), and storage monitoring to generate detailed protocol analysis reports. The tool includes an embedded multi-tab browser with automatic popup capture, making it particularly useful for analyzing complex authentication flows like OAuth.

jure/webphysics.description: WebGPU physics engine based on the AVBD solver
jure/webphysics.blurb: webphysics is an experimental WebGPU-based physics engine that implements rigid-body and soft-body simulation using the AVBD (Augmented Vertex Block Descent) solver. It provides GPU-accelerated physics simulation for web applications, enabling high-performance collision detection, constraint solving, and dynamics computation directly in the browser. The implementation follows the complete AVBD pipeline including broad-phase collision detection with LBVH, narrow-phase contact generation, and parallel constraint solving with body coloring.

patterniha/SNI-Spoofing.blurb: SNI-Spoofing is a Python tool that manipulates IP and TCP headers to bypass Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) systems. It allows users to circumvent network censorship and filtering by spoofing Server Name Indication (SNI) fields in TLS handshakes. The project appears to target Persian-speaking users based on the Farsi text in the documentation.

lzhgus/Capso.description: Open-source screenshot and screen recording for macOS. The free, native alternative to CleanShot X. Built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI.
lzhgus/Capso.blurb: Capso is an open-source screenshot and screen recording application for macOS built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI. It provides a free, native alternative to paid tools like CleanShot X, offering features like area/window capture, scrolling screenshots, video/GIF recording with webcam PiP, annotation tools, OCR text recognition, and screenshot history management. The project is architected as modular SPM packages (CaptureKit, AnnotationKit, OCRKit) that can be reused in other applications.

AgentSeal/codeburn.description: See where your AI coding tokens go. Interactive TUI dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor cost observability.
AgentSeal/codeburn.blurb: CodeBurn is a terminal dashboard that tracks AI coding token usage and costs by parsing Claude Code session transcripts locally. It provides detailed breakdowns by task type, model, project, and success rates to help developers understand where their AI coding budget goes and identify inefficient retry patterns. The tool operates without API keys or proxies by reading session data directly from disk and includes a macOS menu bar widget for quick cost monitoring.

alchaincyf/darwin-skill.description: 达尔文.skill —— 一个让你的Skill无限进化的系统：评估→改进→测试→保留或回滚 | Autoresearch-inspired autonomous skill optimization for Claude Code. Evaluate, improve, test, keep or revert.
alchaincyf/darwin-skill.blurb: Darwin-skill is an autonomous optimization system for Agent Skills that continuously evaluates, improves, tests, and either keeps or reverts changes using a ratchet mechanism that only preserves measurable improvements. It addresses the challenge of maintaining large skill collections (60+ skills) by providing both structural analysis and actual performance testing with an 8-dimensional scoring system, rather than just format validation. Inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch, it implements a human-in-the-loop approach where the system autonomously optimizes individual SKILL.md files but pauses between phases for user confirmation.

yaojingang/GEOFlow.description: Open-source GEO content production system with AI tasks, review workflow, and publishing.
yaojingang/GEOFlow.blurb: GEOFlow is an open-source content production system designed for GEO/SEO content operations, built with PHP and PostgreSQL. It automates the entire content pipeline from AI model configuration and asset management to task scheduling, draft review, and publishing, enabling automated content sites and internal content operations. The system supports OpenAI-compatible APIs and includes Docker deployment with built-in scheduling and worker processes.

shitagaki-lab/see-through.description: "Single-image Layer Decomposition for Anime Characters" (SIGGRAPH 2026, Conditionally Accepted)
shitagaki-lab/see-through.blurb: See-through is a framework that decomposes single anime character illustrations into manipulatable layers, automatically separating elements like hair, face, clothing, and accessories into up to 23 distinct semantic layers. It enables artists and developers to convert static anime artwork into 2.5D models with proper depth ordering and fully inpainted backgrounds for animation or interactive applications. The system uses a combination of diffusion models, depth estimation, and semantic segmentation specifically fine-tuned for anime artwork.

alejandrobalderas/claude-code-from-sourc.description: Architecture, patterns & internals of Anthropic's AI coding agent — reverse-engineered from source maps
alejandrobalderas/claude-code-from-sourc.blurb: This repository contains a reverse-engineered analysis of Anthropic's Claude Code AI agent, documented as an 18-chapter technical book based on TypeScript source maps that were accidentally shipped with the npm package. Engineers can use it to understand production AI agent architecture patterns, multi-agent orchestration, and implementation trade-offs for building their own agentic systems. The content is purely educational pseudocode with no actual Claude source code included.

tianxingleo/ACGTI.description: ACG Type Indicator - MBTI inspired anime persona quiz
tianxingleo/ACGTI.blurb: ACGTI is a TypeScript-based web application that implements an MBTI-inspired personality quiz for anime/manga (ACG) characters. Users answer situational questions to discover their anime personality archetype and get matched with specific characters from popular series like Evangelion, Detective Conan, and Genshin Impact. The application runs entirely in the browser with no backend, processing all calculations locally for privacy.

andrewjiang/palantir-for-family-trips.description: A Palantir-ish dashboard for family trip planning.
andrewjiang/palantir-for-family-trips.blurb: A React-based dashboard that applies military/intelligence UI patterns to family trip coordination, tracking multiple families' routes, timelines, and logistics for shared vacations. It treats trip planning as an "operation" with convoy tracking, mission timelines, and command-center aesthetics instead of traditional calendar tools. The project is intentionally overengineered as a UI experiment that makes coordinating a weekend cabin trip feel like running a live ops room.

wesbos/JSON-Alexander.description: A really good JSON viewer browser Extension
wesbos/JSON-Alexander.blurb: JSON Alexander is a browser extension that provides an enhanced JSON viewer for web pages serving JSON responses. It automatically detects and replaces raw JSON with an interactive tree view featuring syntax highlighting, collapsible nodes, multiple display modes, and path copying functionality. The extension requires disabling Firefox's native JSON viewer to function properly on that browser.

zmeyer44/Locker.blurb: Locker is an open-source, self-hostable file storage and knowledge platform that serves as an alternative to Dropbox and Google Drive. It provides file management capabilities with AI-powered features like document transcription, semantic search, and a knowledge base that can ingest and chat about uploaded documents. The platform supports multiple storage backends, extensible plugins, and includes a virtual bash filesystem for command-line file navigation.

cpaczek/any-buddy.description: Hack Claude Code to get any buddy you want
cpaczek/any-buddy.blurb: This is a TypeScript tool that modifies Claude Code's companion pet system to let users customize their buddy's appearance and traits beyond the default options. Users can select custom species, rarity levels, eye styles, hats, and names through an interactive terminal interface or command-line flags. The project is now deprecated as Anthropic removed the buddy feature from Claude Code in version 0.97.

mrdoob/three.wasm.blurb: three.wasm is a WebAssembly rewrite of the Three.js 3D graphics library that claims 8x performance improvements. It provides a minimal 10KB binary for rendering 3D graphics without JavaScript's garbage collection overhead or JIT compilation delays. The project appears to be a proof-of-concept or satire, as it only demonstrates a spinning cube despite the grandiose claims.

AICoderTudou/claude-code-tudou.blurb: Claude Code Tudou is a locally enhanced fork of leaked Claude Code source that provides both terminal TUI and Electron desktop interfaces for AI-assisted coding. It fixes critical bugs in the original codebase (startup failures, input handling, missing dependencies) and adds support for third-party Anthropic-compatible APIs through environment variables. The project includes built-in agent tools for bash execution, file editing, and code search capabilities.

atomicmemory/llm-wiki-compiler.description: The knowledge compiler. Raw sources in, interlinked wiki out. Inspired by Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
atomicmemory/llm-wiki-compiler.blurb: llm-wiki-compiler is a TypeScript CLI tool that converts raw sources (URLs, files, documents) into an interlinked markdown wiki using LLM-powered concept extraction. It addresses the limitation of RAG systems that re-discover knowledge at query time by compiling sources once into a persistent, browsable knowledge base where concepts get dedicated pages and relationships accumulate over time. The tool uses a two-phase pipeline with incremental compilation and hash-based change detection to avoid reprocessing unchanged sources.

code-yeongyu/not-claude-code-emulator.description: ULTRA DANGEROUS CLAUDE CODE EMULATOR; MAKING THE API REQUEST IDENTICAL TO CLAUDE CODE
code-yeongyu/not-claude-code-emulator.blurb: A proxy server that emulates Claude's API by handling OAuth authentication and providing an OpenAPI-compatible Messages API with token management. It allows developers to integrate with Claude's services through a standardized REST interface with built-in streaming support and automatic token handling. The project has been archived in favor of CLIProxyAPI, which supports multiple AI providers including Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT.

bstnxbt/dflash-mlx.description: Lossless DFlash speculative decoding for MLX on Apple Silicon
bstnxbt/dflash-mlx.blurb: DFlash-mlx implements the DFlash speculative decoding algorithm optimized for Apple Silicon using MLX, where a small draft model generates 16 tokens in parallel that are then verified by a larger target model. It accelerates language model inference by 1.35x to 4.13x while maintaining lossless output quality, making it useful for faster text generation on Apple hardware. The implementation includes custom Metal kernels for tape-replay rollback and numerical stability to handle the complexities of speculative decoding with recurrent model states.

761696148/Game-Map-Tracker.blurb: Game Map Real-time Tracker is a computer vision tool that automatically identifies the mini-map in games and displays the player's real-time position on a high-resolution overlay map. It enables players to track their exact location without alt-tabbing to external maps, using either traditional SIFT feature matching or deep learning-based LoFTR for robust tracking even with UI occlusion. The AI mode has been optimized to run on less than 1GB of VRAM, making it accessible for lower-end hardware.

sogonov/anubis.description: Android app manager with VPN integration. Manages groups of apps by freezing/unfreezing them based on VPN connection state.
sogonov/anubis.blurb: Anubis is an Android app manager that freezes and unfreezes groups of applications based on VPN connection state. It ensures apps only run with their intended network configuration by completely disabling them at the system level using `pm disable-user`, preventing any network detection or data transmission. Unlike sandbox solutions that isolate apps in work profiles, disabled apps cannot execute any code or inspect the shared network stack to detect VPN presence.

amitshekhariitbhu/llm-internals.description: Learn LLM internals step by step - from tokenization to attention to inference optimization.
amitshekhariitbhu/llm-internals.blurb: This is an educational repository that explains the internal workings of Large Language Models through step-by-step tutorials covering tokenization, attention mechanisms, and inference optimization. It provides detailed mathematical explanations with numeric examples to help engineers understand core LLM concepts like Byte Pair Encoding, Q/K/V attention matrices, scaling factors, and causal masking. The content is delivered through both written blogs and video tutorials, making complex LLM internals accessible to practitioners.

vercel-labs/wterm.description: A terminal emulator for the web
vercel-labs/wterm.blurb: wterm is a web-based terminal emulator with a Zig core compiled to WebAssembly and DOM rendering. It provides native browser features like text selection, clipboard support, and accessibility while maintaining near-native performance through a lightweight WASM binary. The core terminal logic compiles to just ~12KB and includes full VT100/VT220/xterm escape sequence support with features like alternate screen buffers and 24-bit color.

mohi-devhub/antivibe.description: Learn what AI writes, not just accept it. A Claude Code skill that turns AI-generated code into educational deep dives.
mohi-devhub/antivibe.blurb: AntiVibe is a Claude Code skill that generates detailed educational explanations of AI-generated code instead of letting developers blindly copy-paste. It transforms code into learning guides that explain the what, why, when, and alternatives behind implementation decisions, helping developers actually understand what AI writes. The framework automatically triggers after task completion and outputs structured markdown files with concept explanations and curated learning resources.

CITGuru/openduck.description: Distributed DuckDB - dual execution and differential storage
CITGuru/openduck.blurb: OpenDuck is an open-source implementation of MotherDuck's distributed DuckDB architecture, providing differential storage, hybrid execution, and transparent remote database access through a DuckDB extension. It allows queries to seamlessly span local and remote data sources, with the system automatically splitting execution plans between your machine and cloud workers while maintaining DuckDB's native catalog interface. The project uses a minimal gRPC protocol with Arrow IPC for data transfer, making it backend-agnostic and extensible.

rasbt/mini-coding-agent.description: Minimal and readable coding agent harness implementation in Python to explain the core components of coding agents.
rasbt/mini-coding-agent.blurb: Mini-Coding-Agent is a minimal Python implementation that demonstrates the core components of a coding agent harness for educational purposes. It provides a local agent loop with workspace context collection, structured tools with approval gates, transcript persistence, and bounded delegation to help developers understand how coding agents work. The implementation has no external Python dependencies beyond the standard library and uses Ollama as the model backend.

SAGAR-TAMANG/friday-tony-stark-demo.description: Demo of tools of capabilities of Tony Stark.
SAGAR-TAMANG/friday-tony-stark-demo.blurb: F.R.I.D.A.Y. is a Tony Stark-inspired AI voice assistant built with Python that combines a FastMCP server backend with a LiveKit voice agent frontend. It allows users to interact via voice with an LLM (Gemini 2.5 Flash) that can call various tools like web search, news retrieval, and system information through real-time communication between the voice pipeline and MCP server. The system uses a two-component architecture where the MCP server exposes tools over Server-Sent Events and the voice agent handles speech-to-text, LLM reasoning, and text-to-speech in a LiveKit room.

kargnas/damn-my-slow-kt.description: 명령어 설치 한번으로 한달 KT 인터넷 요금을 무료로 쓸 수 있습니다. 귀찮은 공문 작성 필요 없습니다.
kargnas/damn-my-slow-kt.blurb: This is a TypeScript CLI tool that automates KT (Korean ISP) internet speed testing and billing compensation claims. It continuously monitors internet speeds against SLA requirements and automatically submits compensation requests when speeds fall below contractual minimums, potentially reducing monthly internet bills to zero. The tool requires KT's official speed testing program and only works on macOS/Windows since KT doesn't support Linux.

lucasastorian/llmwiki.description: Open Source Implementation of Karpathy's LLM Wiki. Upload documents, connect your Claude account via MCP, and have it write your wiki !
lucasastorian/llmwiki.blurb: LLMWiki is an open-source implementation of Karpathy's LLM Wiki concept that creates AI-maintained knowledge bases from uploaded documents. Users upload PDFs and documents, connect their Claude account via MCP (Model Context Protocol), and Claude automatically generates interconnected wiki pages with citations, cross-references, and summaries that compound over time rather than re-deriving answers from raw chunks. The system uses a three-layer architecture separating immutable source documents, LLM-generated wiki content, and tools that allow Claude to search, read, and write across the entire knowledge vault.

bddicken/tuitter.blurb: Tuitter is a terminal-based Twitter/X client built with TypeScript and OpenTUI. It allows users to authenticate with their X developer credentials and browse or interact with Twitter content directly from the command line. The project includes optional daily usage limits that can be configured to restrict screen time.

IyadhKhalfallah/clauditor.description: Stop Claude Code from burning through your quota in 20 minutes. Auto-rotates oversized sessions and preserves context.
IyadhKhalfallah/clauditor.blurb: clauditor is a CLI tool that prevents Claude Code sessions from burning through API quota by monitoring token usage and blocking oversized sessions. It automatically saves session context and rotates to fresh sessions when token waste becomes excessive (e.g., 200k tokens/turn vs 20k for fresh sessions). The tool works by registering hooks into Claude Code that intercept prompts and detect when sessions have grown inefficiently large.

millionco/cli-to-js.description: Turn any CLI into a JavaScript API
millionco/cli-to-js.blurb: cli-to-js is a TypeScript library that automatically converts command-line tools into typed JavaScript APIs by parsing their `--help` output. It enables programmatic interaction with any CLI tool through a structured interface where subcommands become methods and flags become typed options, eliminating the need to construct shell command strings manually. The library includes validation that catches invalid flag names and provides correction suggestions, making it particularly useful for AI agents that need to interact with system tools.

JrCx7scC/claude-code-source.description: Claude Code complete source restoration from npm package — all native modules, no features cut
JrCx7scC/claude-code-source.blurb: This project reverse-engineers the complete source code of Anthropic's Claude Code from its npm package, restoring all native modules, internal dependencies, and type definitions that were stripped from the public release. It allows developers to run a fully-featured local instance of Claude Code with capabilities like Computer Use, voice input, MCP server integration, and all CLI tools intact. The restoration includes native binaries extracted from official releases across multiple platforms and preserves 90+ feature flags that control advanced functionality.

airbnb/javascript.blurb: Airbnb's JavaScript Style Guide is a comprehensive set of coding conventions and best practices for writing JavaScript code. Teams and developers adopt it to maintain consistent code quality, readability, and to leverage modern ES6+ features across their JavaScript projects. With over 148k stars, it has become one of the most widely adopted JavaScript style guides in the industry, complete with accompanying ESLint configurations for automated enforcement.

WeaveMindAI/weft.description: A programming language for AI systems
WeaveMindAI/weft.blurb: Weft is a Rust-based programming language designed specifically for building AI systems that integrate LLMs, humans, APIs, and infrastructure as first-class primitives. It provides durable execution with automatic state management, type-safe orchestration of multi-step workflows that can pause for human input and resume days later, and generates visual program graphs automatically. The language is in early development with an intentionally small but opinionated node catalog, positioning itself as a foundation for AI system development rather than a production-ready tool.

Manavarya09/design-extract.description: Extract any website's complete design system with one command. DTCG tokens, semantic+primitive+composite, MCP server for Claude Code/Cursor/Windsurf, multi-platform emitters (iOS SwiftUI, Android Compose, Flutter, WordPress), Tailwind v4, Figma variables, shadcn/ui, CSS health audit, WCAG remediation, Chrome extension. MIT, Playwright, Node 20+.
Manavarya09/design-extract.blurb: designlang is a CLI tool that reverse-engineers complete design systems from any website by extracting colors, typography, spacing, shadows, layout patterns, and responsive behavior. It generates 8 output files including Tailwind configs, design tokens, React themes, and an AI-optimized markdown summary that can be fed to LLMs to recreate the design. Unlike other design extraction tools, it captures layout architecture, responsive breakpoints, and interaction states rather than just basic colors and fonts.

BuilderPulse/BuilderPulse.description: AI-powered daily intelligence for indie hackers and builders. 20 questions, 10+ sources, every morning.
