BuilderPulse/BuilderPulse.blurb: BuilderPulse is an AI-powered intelligence service that analyzes 300+ daily signals from platforms like Hacker News, GitHub, Product Hunt, and Reddit to identify building opportunities for indie hackers. It delivers actionable insights through daily reports that highlight trending topics, market gaps, and specific 2-hour project suggestions based on real user demand and discussion patterns. The service provides bilingual coverage (English/Chinese) and maintains a public archive of daily analyses accessible via GitHub.

Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-World-2.0.description: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-World-2.0.blurb: HY-World 2.0 is a multi-modal world model framework that generates and reconstructs 3D worlds from diverse inputs including text, single images, multi-view images, and videos. It enables synthesis of navigable 3D scenes from minimal input and performs 3D reconstruction through a unified feed-forward model called WorldMirror 2.0 that predicts depth, normals, camera parameters, and 3D Gaussian Splatting attributes in a single pass. The system uses a four-stage pipeline combining panorama generation, trajectory planning, world expansion, and world composition components.

millionco/isolet.description: Package any component into a self-contained, isolated widget
millionco/isolet.blurb: isolet is a TypeScript library that packages any component into a self-contained, isolated widget using shadow DOM. It supports multiple frameworks (React, Solid, Svelte, vanilla JS) and can output widgets as script tags, ESM imports, or CommonJS modules with scoped styles that don't leak. The CLI automatically inlines CSS assets as data URIs and resolves dependencies at build time for truly portable widgets.

Nightmare-Eclipse/RedSun.blurb: RedSun is a proof-of-concept exploit that abuses Windows Defender's cloud tag handling behavior. It leverages Defender's file rewriting mechanism to overwrite system files and escalate privileges when the antivirus detects a malicious file with a cloud tag. The vulnerability exploits the counterintuitive behavior where Windows Defender rewrites detected malicious files back to their original location instead of removing them.

lewislulu/html-ppt-skill.description: HTML PPT Studio — AgentSkill with 24 themes, 31 layouts, 20+ animations for building professional HTML presentations
lewislulu/html-ppt-skill.blurb: HTML PPT Studio is an AgentSkill for generating professional HTML presentations with 36 themes, 31 layouts, and 47 animations using pure static HTML/CSS/JS. It enables AI agents to create presentation decks from natural language prompts like "make a 8-page tech presentation with cyberpunk theme" without requiring any build tools or compilation steps. The project includes 14 full-deck templates extracted from real-world presentations and supports both CSS animations and canvas-based effects.

xataio/xata.description: Open source, cloud native, Postgres platform with copy-on-write branching and scale-to-zero
xataio/xata.blurb: Xata is an open-source, cloud-native platform for self-hosting multiple Postgres instances on Kubernetes with copy-on-write branching and scale-to-zero capabilities. It's designed for organizations that need internal Postgres-as-a-Service or efficient dev/testing environments where you can clone terabytes of data in seconds and automatically scale down idle instances. The platform runs on CloudNativePG and OpenEBS, providing production-grade features like high availability, automatic failover, and PITR backups out of the box.

nirholas/fresh-start.description: The original nirholas/claude-code before DMCA and take down. Once everything is cleared, it will return. Working with Anthropic and Github to get everything back.
nirholas/fresh-start.blurb: Fresh Start is a GitHub repository with 6,370 stars but lacks a description or README content to indicate its purpose. Without documentation or visible code, it's impossible to determine what functionality this project provides or why developers would use it. The high star count suggests it may have had significant content that has since been removed or the repository may be archived.

docsagent/docsagent.description: DocsAgent is a local-first AI documents assistant that lets you securely index and chat with thousands of desktop documents with zero cloud leakage.
docsagent/docsagent.blurb: DocsAgent is a local-first AI document assistant that provides secure indexing and search across thousands of desktop files without cloud dependencies. It integrates with AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to give them access to your private documents while maintaining complete data privacy. The system uses a native C++ engine for millisecond-level retrieval performance and supports PDF, Word, and PowerPoint formats.

EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui.description: Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics
EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui.blurb: Hermes Web UI is a Vue-based web dashboard that provides centralized management for Hermes Agent, a multi-platform AI chatbot system. It enables configuration and monitoring of AI chat sessions across 8 platforms (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, etc.), usage analytics, scheduled jobs, and system settings through a single interface. The dashboard includes an integrated web terminal and automatically discovers available AI models from configured provider credentials.

WeianMao/triattention.description: TriAttention — Efficient long reasoning with trigonometric KV cache compression. Enables OpenClaw local deployment on memory-constrained GPUs.
WeianMao/triattention.blurb: TriAttention is a KV cache compression technique for transformer models that uses trigonometric frequency-domain compression to reduce memory usage during long sequence inference. It achieves 10.7x KV memory reduction and 2.5x throughput improvement on long reasoning tasks while maintaining accuracy, enabling deployment of large language models on memory-constrained GPUs like the RTX 4090. The method works by leveraging the observation that pre-RoPE Q/K vectors concentrate around fixed centers that can be exploited for efficient compression without requiring representative query selection.

Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-Embodied.description: HY-Embodied: Embodied Foundation Models for Real-World Agents
Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-Embodied.blurb: HY-Embodied is a family of foundation models specifically designed for embodied AI and real-world robotic agents, featuring 2B and 32B parameter variants with a novel Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. It enables robots to perform spatial-temporal visual perception and complex reasoning tasks like planning and interaction, serving as the "brain" for Vision-Language-Action pipelines in physical robot control. The 2B model uses only 2.2B activated parameters during inference while maintaining the performance of larger dense models through large-to-small distillation from the 32B variant.

Jakubantalik/border-beam.description: Animated border beam effect for React
Jakubantalik/border-beam.blurb: BorderBeam is a React component that creates an animated traveling glow effect around the border of any wrapped element. It provides configurable color schemes, sizes, and animation controls for adding visual polish to cards, buttons, and other UI components. The component automatically detects border radius and uses GPU-accelerated CSS animations with pointer-events disabled to avoid interfering with wrapped content.

millionco/claude-doctor.blurb: Claude Doctor is a TypeScript CLI tool that analyzes Claude AI conversation transcripts stored in `~/.claude/` to identify behavioral anti-patterns and problematic usage signals. It detects issues like edit thrashing, error loops, correction-heavy sessions, and sentiment drift to help developers understand when their Claude interactions are ineffective. The tool can automatically generate ready-to-paste rules for CLAUDE.md files based on your actual conversation history patterns.

browser-use/video-use.blurb: video-use is an open-source Python tool that enables AI-powered video editing through Claude Code conversations. It automatically cuts filler words, applies color grading, burns subtitles, and generates animations by feeding the LLM text transcripts with word-level timestamps instead of raw video frames. The system uses a self-evaluation loop that checks rendered output quality at every cut boundary before presenting the final result.

Robbyant/lingbot-map.description: A feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data
Robbyant/lingbot-map.blurb: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming image/video data using a Geometric Context Transformer architecture. It enables real-time 3D reconstruction at ~20 FPS with superior accuracy compared to existing streaming and optimization-based methods, making it suitable for applications requiring live scene understanding. The model uses paged KV cache attention for efficient processing of long sequences exceeding 10,000 frames without drift accumulation.

wbh604/UZI-Skill.description: 冰冷的钱就这样流进我温暖的口袋-游资（UZI）Skills — 51位投资大佬帮你看盘 · 22维数据 × 180条量化规则 × 17种机构分析方法 · A股/港股/美股
wbh604/UZI-Skill.blurb: UZI-Skill is a Chinese stock analysis engine that uses AI to generate comprehensive investment reports for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, and US stocks. It processes 22 data dimensions through 180 quantitative rules and 17 institutional analysis methods, with 51 different investment personalities (from Buffett to Chinese day traders) providing scored evaluations. The tool outputs Bloomberg-style HTML reports, social media graphics, and uses only free data sources with zero API keys required.

op7418/logo-generator-skill.blurb: This is an SVG logo generator that creates professional logos with multiple design variants and high-end showcase presentations. It's designed for startups, developers, and product teams who need quality logos quickly without the traditional back-and-forth with designers. The tool generates 6+ logo variants per request and creates professional showcase images using 12 different background styles through Gemini AI integration.

cloudflare/agentic-inbox.description: A self-hosted email client with an AI agent, running entirely on Cloudflare Workers
cloudflare/agentic-inbox.blurb: Agentic Inbox is a self-hosted email client that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers infrastructure, using Email Routing for message delivery, Durable Objects for per-mailbox SQLite storage, and R2 for attachments. It provides a full-featured web email interface with an integrated AI agent that can read messages, search conversations, and automatically draft replies using Cloudflare's Workers AI platform. The AI agent automatically generates draft replies for incoming emails but requires explicit user confirmation before sending.

massgravel/Microsoft-Activation-Scripts.description: Open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.
massgravel/Microsoft-Activation-Scripts.blurb: Microsoft Activation Scripts (MAS) is an open-source tool that bypasses Windows and Office activation requirements using multiple methods including HWID, KMS, and Ohook techniques. It provides a way to activate Microsoft products without purchasing legitimate licenses, which violates Microsoft's terms of service but is widely used for testing or cost avoidance. The project has gained significant traction with over 172k GitHub stars and offers both PowerShell and traditional batch file execution methods.

poteto/how.blurb: A Cursor IDE plugin that adds a `/how` skill for generating architectural explanations of codebases at a senior engineer level. It automatically chooses between simple single-agent explanations or complex multi-agent exploration with parallel subagents that analyze different aspects before synthesizing findings into structured documentation. The plugin includes an optional critique mode that spawns independent critics across different models to identify architectural problems.

Lazarus-AI/clearwing.blurb: Clearwing is an autonomous vulnerability scanner and source-code hunter built on LangGraph that operates in two modes: network penetration testing with 63 tools and source code vulnerability analysis. It provides AI-driven security testing capabilities using publicly available models, offering an alternative to proprietary tools like Anthropic's Glasswing for automated vulnerability discovery and exploitation. The tool includes human approval guardrails for exploit attempts and generates comprehensive reports with explicit evidence levels from suspicion through patch validation.

stanford-iris-lab/meta-harness.description: Reference code for the Meta-Harness paper.
stanford-iris-lab/meta-harness.blurb: Meta-Harness is a framework for automated search and optimization of task-specific model harnesses—the code that manages what to store, retrieve, and present to a base model during execution. It enables automatic improvement of the scaffolding around LLM agents by iteratively evolving components like memory systems and execution frameworks rather than manually engineering them. The framework includes reference implementations for text classification memory optimization and Terminal-Bench 2.0 scaffold evolution.

maeil-mail/maeil-mail-contents.description: 📮 매일메일 기술 면접 컨텐츠 아카이브 (FE, BE)
maeil-mail/maeil-mail-contents.blurb: This is an archive repository containing technical interview questions and content from the discontinued maeil-mail.kr service, organized for both frontend and backend roles. Developers can use it as a reference for technical interview preparation, with content categorized by question ID and topic areas. The repository preserves what appears to be a curated collection of Korean-language technical interview materials that would otherwise be lost after the service shutdown.

EvolutionAPI/evo-nexus.description: The open source operating system for AI-powered businesses
EvolutionAPI/evo-nexus.blurb: EvoNexus is a TypeScript-based multi-agent operating system that orchestrates 38 specialized AI agents for business operations and software development workflows. It provides automated daily routines including financial reporting, community monitoring, code reviews, and strategic planning while supporting multiple LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, etc.) through a unified interface. The system uses markdown-based agent definitions rather than code, making it extensible without requiring compilation or SDK knowledge.

codejunkie99/agentic-stack.description: One brain, many harnesses. Portable .agent/ folder (memory + skills + protocols) that plugs into Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, or DIY Python — and keeps its knowledge when you switch.
codejunkie99/agentic-stack.blurb: Agentic-stack is a portable AI agent framework that packages memory, skills, and protocols into a standardized `.agent/` folder structure. It allows developers to maintain consistent AI agent state and knowledge across different coding environments like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and others without losing context when switching tools. The system includes an automated review protocol where the agent stages learning candidates nightly, but requires human approval before incorporating them into long-term semantic memory.

getagentseal/codeburn.description: See where your AI coding tokens go. Interactive TUI dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor cost observability.
getagentseal/codeburn.blurb: CodeBurn is a terminal-based dashboard that tracks token usage and costs across AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. It helps developers monitor where their AI coding budget is being spent by analyzing session data, tracking success rates, and identifying inefficient usage patterns. The tool works by directly reading session data from disk without requiring API keys or proxies, and includes a native macOS menubar app.

bwjoke/BTC-Trading-Since-2020.blurb: This is a public dataset containing nearly six years of real Bitcoin trading data from a single account, including 43k+ orders and 173k+ execution records from BitMEX. It provides researchers and traders with a complete, timestamped archive of actual trading decisions and outcomes across multiple market cycles, rather than selective narratives or curated performance stories. The dataset emphasizes decision-making under uncertainty and includes comprehensive execution ledgers, wallet histories, and position snapshots that were made public before outcomes were known.

bergside/design-md-chrome.description: Chrome extension to extract styles from any website and generate DESIGN.md files and design skills for AI based on TypeUI
bergside/design-md-chrome.blurb: A Chrome extension that extracts design system elements (typography, colors, spacing, etc.) from any website and generates standardized DESIGN.md or SKILL.md files. It enables developers to quickly capture and document design patterns from existing sites for use with AI coding tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot. The extension outputs files in the TypeUI DESIGN.md format, providing structured documentation that includes style foundations, accessibility requirements, and implementation rules.

lewislulu/llm-wiki-skill.description: Karpathy-style LLM knowledge base Agent Skill for OpenClaw/Codex. Experimental — will iterate over time.
lewislulu/llm-wiki-skill.blurb: This is an OpenClaw/Codex agent skill that builds persistent, cross-linked Markdown knowledge bases where LLMs compile and organize raw sources into a structured wiki format, inspired by Andrej Karpathy's approach. It replaces traditional RAG retrieval with a compounding knowledge system where each compile/ingest/query cycle makes the wiki richer, with the LLM handling all writing and cross-referencing while humans provide sources and feedback. The project includes Obsidian plugin integration and a local web viewer with audit capabilities for iterative knowledge base improvement.

imbue-ai/bouncer.blurb: Bouncer is a browser extension that uses AI to filter unwanted posts from Twitter/X feeds based on natural language filter definitions. It allows users to define filter topics in plain language (like "crypto" or "engagement bait") and automatically hides matching posts in real-time using various AI models. The extension supports both local on-device inference via WebGPU and cloud-based AI services, with multimodal capabilities to filter based on both text and images.

browser-use/browser-harness.description: Browser Harness | Self-healing harness that enables LLMs to complete any task.
browser-use/browser-harness.blurb: Browser Harness is a self-healing Python library that connects LLMs directly to Chrome via CDP to automate browser tasks. It allows LLMs to modify their own helper functions mid-task when encountering missing functionality, requiring no predefined recipes or framework constraints. The entire codebase is ~592 lines with no abstraction layers between the agent and the browser websocket connection.

zhuyansen/wx-favorites-report.description: 微信收藏可视化 Claude Code Skill — 从加密 DB 到交互式 HTML 报告的端到端管线
zhuyansen/wx-favorites-report.blurb: This is a Python tool that extracts and visualizes WeChat favorites data from the encrypted local database on macOS. It provides an end-to-end pipeline to decrypt WeChat's SQLCipher database and generate interactive HTML reports with statistics, trends, word clouds, and searchable content browsing. The implementation uses Frida to hook system PBKDF2 functions for key extraction, which is necessary because WeChat's favorites database keys are only loaded when the user opens the favorites page.

cathrynlavery/diagram-design.description: Thirteen editorial diagram types for Claude Code. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows, no Mermaid-slop.
cathrynlavery/diagram-design.blurb: This is a collection of 13 editorial-quality diagram templates delivered as self-contained HTML+SVG files. It functions as a Claude Code skill to generate custom diagrams in your brand colors and typography, replacing generic Mermaid output. Each diagram type ships in minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial variants with no build dependencies.

NikolayS/pgque.description: PgQue – Zero-bloat Postgres queue. One SQL file to install, pg_cron to tick.
NikolayS/pgque.blurb: PgQue is a PostgreSQL-based message queue implemented entirely in PL/pgSQL that runs on any Postgres 14+ instance without requiring extensions or external daemons. It provides a durable event stream with independent per-consumer cursors and avoids the performance degradation common in SKIP LOCKED queues by using snapshot-based batching and table rotation instead of row-level deletion. The implementation is based on the battle-tested PgQ architecture originally designed at Skype but rebuilt to work on managed Postgres providers.

QuipNetwork/quip-protocol-rs.description: A rust implementation of the Quip Protocol forked from Substrate
QuipNetwork/quip-protocol-rs.blurb: QuipNetwork/quip-protocol-rs is a Rust implementation of the Quip Protocol built on the Substrate blockchain framework. It provides a ready-to-use node template for building custom blockchains with Substrate's modular runtime architecture and consensus mechanisms. Despite having 5,041 stars, the repository appears to still contain mostly unmodified Substrate node template documentation.

kyegomez/OpenMythos.description: A theoretical reconstruction of the Claude Mythos architecture, built from first principles using the available research literature.
kyegomez/OpenMythos.blurb: OpenMythos is a theoretical reconstruction of Claude's Mythos architecture implemented as a Recurrent-Depth Transformer (RDT) that loops a subset of transformer layers multiple times per forward pass. It enables compute-adaptive reasoning by allowing variable loop iterations during inference, potentially improving systematic generalization without generating intermediate tokens. The implementation uses input injection at each loop iteration to prevent hidden state drift and includes switchable attention mechanisms (MLA/GQA) with sparse MoE layers.

EvoLinkAI/awesome-gpt-image-2-prompts.description: Curated GPT-Image-2 prompts fot the Openai API：image examples across portraits, posters, UI mockups, character sheets, and community experiments.
EvoLinkAI/awesome-gpt-image-2-prompts.blurb: This is a curated collection of high-quality prompts and image examples for GPT-Image-2, covering categories like portraits, posters, UI mockups, and character sheets. It serves as a reference library for developers and creators looking to generate specific types of images with effective prompt patterns. The repository sources examples from X/Twitter, creator communities, and public demos to provide real-world use cases.

VoltAgent/awesome-claude-design.description: Awesome Claude Design: 68 ready-to-use design system inspirations in DESIGN.md format. Drop one in, scaffold a full UI in one shot.
VoltAgent/awesome-claude-design.blurb: This is a curated collection of 68 ready-to-use DESIGN.md files that work with Claude Design to generate complete UI design systems from a single file upload. Teams use it to skip the blank-page problem when starting design projects by selecting an aesthetic template that Claude Design then expands into a full design system with colors, typography, components, and working UI kits. The DESIGN.md format bridges human design intent with AI actionability by combining specific design tokens with the rationale behind design decisions.

ZJU-REAL/ClawGUI.description: Build, Evaluate, and Deploy GUI Agents — online RL training, standardized benchmarks, and real-device deployment in one framework.
ZJU-REAL/ClawGUI.blurb: ClawGUI is a unified framework for building, evaluating, and deploying GUI agents that can control graphical interfaces through natural language commands. It provides online reinforcement learning training with parallel environments, standardized benchmarking across multiple datasets, and real-device deployment capabilities for mobile agents. The framework includes GiGPO (a novel RL algorithm) and demonstrates end-to-end validation with ClawGUI-2B, which achieves 17.1% success rate on MobileWorld compared to an 11.1% baseline.

kapishdima/remocn.description: Production-ready animations, transitions, backgrounds, and scenes for Remotion. A shadcn registry that lets you `npx shadcn add` polished video components into any Remotion project. Built for solo builders shipping demo videos fast
kapishdima/remocn.blurb: remocn is a shadcn-style component registry that provides production-ready animations, transitions, and video scenes for Remotion projects. It allows developers to quickly add polished video components via `npx shadcn add` instead of building every animation from scratch, targeting solo builders and small teams who need demo videos shipped fast. The library includes 64+ components across text animations, backgrounds, transitions, UI blocks, and full compositions that get copied into your codebase for full ownership and customization.

joyehuang/Learn-Open-Harness.description: 🤖 Official Interactive Tutorial for OpenHarness – Zero to Hero in 12 Chapters | Learn OpenHarness like Claude Code: Agent Loop, Tools, Memory, Multi-Agent | 面向零基础的 AI Agent 交互式教程
joyehuang/Learn-Open-Harness.blurb: This is an interactive tutorial for learning OpenHarness, the open-source AI agent framework that powers tools like Claude Code and Cursor. It breaks down OpenHarness's 11,700+ lines of infrastructure code into 12 digestible chapters covering agent loops, tools, memory systems, and multi-agent collaboration through hands-on simulators and quizzes. The tutorial was built immediately after OpenHarness launched to make the complex agent harness pattern accessible to developers without AI experience.

bitjaru/styleseed.description: Claude Code & Cursor design system. Stop generating ugly AI UI. 69 design rules + 48 shadcn components + Toss/Stripe/Linear/Vercel/Notion brand skins. Tailwind v4 + Radix.
bitjaru/styleseed.blurb: StyleSeed is a design system that provides 69 visual design rules and brand skins for AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor to generate professional-looking UIs. It teaches LLMs design judgment rather than just design data, helping avoid the generic appearance typical of AI-generated interfaces. Components can instantly switch between brand styles (Toss, Stripe, Linear, etc.) using a simple `data-skin` attribute without code rewrites.

ConardLi/easy-agent.description: Fully recreating Claude Code from scratch, so anyone can learn how it works.
ConardLi/easy-agent.blurb: Easy Agent is an open-source TypeScript project that recreates Claude Code's functionality from scratch as a terminal-native coding agent. It provides a local agentic coding system with multi-turn orchestration, tool execution, and extensibility for developers who want to understand or customize how AI coding assistants work. The project uses a five-layer architecture separating concerns from model communication to terminal UI, currently in active development following a 30-phase roadmap.
